scope: Full reward-film contact review, acting corrections and native pause fix
changes: Position the cat after sampling its pose; do not overwrite scene offsets.
Keep a constant cat scale; lift above container rims before lateral movement and descent.
Reveal the scarf along an external path with tail clearance; keep its ball on the stage.
Catch the fish on both paws below the face, with a clear approach path.
Use paw surfaces and IK for the balloon ribbon, watering can and star prize.
Give the duck an open seat; ground resting props and add contact shadows.
Show pollen before the sneeze; settle feathers and petals onto the stage.
Use flush stage inlays and check static stages as well as actor framing.
Keep the native autoplay prop stable; start and stop via the playback API without reloading the GIF.

assertions: bidirectional evaluated-mesh penetration with ray parity
watering-can and star handles touch their paws

coverage: pixel-identical movie frame before and after Pause
wallet and progress unchanged by viewing/sharing
native.setup: A fresh isolated simulator required dismissing the Expo developer introduction and menu; onboarding was not completed. Simulator shut down after the run.

limitations: Authored animation, not a rigid-body or cloth simulation.
Sampled vertex penetration checks do not prove exhaustive continuous triangle/self-collision correctness.
Ten plots are reused across the reward collection.
No child playtesting, Android verification or physical-device performance measurements.
